name: What's the difference between under-cabinet and wall-mounted range hood installation?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between under-cabinet and wall-mounted range hood installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under-cabinet range hoods are installed directly beneath existing kitchen cabinets, often utilizing the cabinet space above. Wall-mounted range hoods, on the other hand, attach directly to the wall and typically stand alone without upper cabinetry. A practical tradeoff is that under-cabinet models usually integrate more subtly and are ideal for maximizing cabinet storage, while wall-mounted models, especially chimney styles, can become a significant design feature but require an open wall space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Under-cabinet hoods fit below existing cabinets; wall-mounted hoods attach directly to the wall. Under-cabinet models save space, while wall-mounted can be a design feature.
